flags.reason: misreads-source: The guide's In context says only that "Refresh swaps the list for a spinner and a line of text while the statements load". It gives no size, and the guide's sizing advice never mentions 40 px (it suggests 56 px for one section, 88 px for a whole screen). The guide also never says Refresh is off while loading, so "Refresh is off while it loads, as in the guide's own example" claims a disabled state nothing cited supports.

notes: /useWhen/1 lists the core principle ("Show that something is happening, then get out of the way") as a use-when condition. It is a guiding principle, not a situation, so a human may want to move it. /examples/1 puts the text line "under" the spinner, where the guide says "next to it"; this is minor. There is no durationMs entry under /facts/props (index 2 is missing), but that is a gap in coverage, not a misstatement.
